scope: Local macOS arm64 public SDK connection-entry tests against controlled real TLS/QUIC endpoints with signed server frames. No product/protocol/dependency behavior changed. This does not replace full operating-profile or installed-package qualification.
assertions: Initial hello offers only the current application profile and bearer authentication, without a credential. An invalid challenge receives no credential response.
An incompatible handshake creates no SDK owner, application command, retry/downgrade connection or application HTTP connection. Refusal closes the physical connection and the host joins.

Transport-only ALPN refusal returns TransportUncertain; invalid wire versions/selected profile return Protocol; signed challenge capability/correlation/signature or session owner/correlation refusal returns Authentication. These connection failures have ReadOnly certainty, no Operation identity and no echoed private credentials or session token.
Both current signed profile/Identity bindings connect under each public entry point; capability read is local and close joins the owned worker/reader.
